# Continuous Improvement

Every process can improve. Every team can improve.

Sustainable systems outperform individual heroics. Improvement should be documented, shared, and measurable.

---

## The Loop

```
Measure → Analyse → Improve → Validate → Repeat
```

---

## What Good Looks Like

- Regular retrospectives at team and department level
- Improvement actions are tracked and followed up
- Learning is visible and shared
- Mistakes lead to system improvements, not blame

---

## Retrospective Levels

- Team — every sprint
- Incident — after every significant incident
- Architecture — periodically for significant decisions
- Department — quarterly

---

## Anti-Patterns

- Repeating known issues without addressing root causes
- Retrospectives with no follow-up actions
- Resistance to change
- Improvement dependent on individual heroics
